name: Agency Floor Plans
description: Daily known-agency discovery, verified building matching and budgeted architectural plan interpretation. Vector geometry and source evidence are stored in geodata; meshes are derived on demand. A limited backfill, blocked sites or failed processing remain partial rather than claiming complete coverage.

schedule.description: Daily at 06:00 UTC; up to three hours of bounded work, checked after four hours.

successCriteria.description: Stats are written atomically after querying current source associations and stored vector artifacts. Normal pending provider batches and zero new plans are allowed; stale runs, empty source walks, source/processing failures and ambiguous paid submissions fail. Current processed-plan and publication counts are evidence, not a mandatory daily new-plan quota. Partial backfill/source coverage deliberately remains visible.
